info.title: Monid API
info.description: Agentic payment platform for data — agents discover and buy data on demand. Authenticated `/v1/*` routes accept a Monid API key or Clerk JWT as a Bearer token. All errors return `{ code, message }`. List endpoints use cursor pagination; consult each operation schema for its last-page cursor encoding.

Bearer.description: Monid API key (`Authorization: Bearer mk_...`) or Clerk-issued JWT.

identities.description: External identities linked to this user (e.g. a World ID). The Clerk login itself is not listed.

autoReload.description: Opt in to auto-reload (with the service defaults) when this checkout completes. Opt-in ONLY: the system never enables auto-reload on the caller's behalf, so `false` and an omitted field are equivalent and record nothing.
